text:
matt_platform: Flagging a recurring discrepancy: invoice preview shows higher token counts than ledger after we enabled per-route fallback + quota gating. Seeing it across a small set of tenants.
zoe_product: can you give a minimal repro/trace? Is this related to attempt vs serve events or pre-throttle counts?
matt_platform: example: tenant=t-good, route=chat-stream. Preview total=1.5M tokens for March 29 window, ledger shows 930k. Logs show both `request_event` (requested_tokens) and `serve_event` (served_tokens) being ingested, plus a `quota_reject` in some traces. Preview aggregates everything by fingerprint||tenant||hour so requested+served get counted.
arjun_metering: yep that matches my quick look. Runtime emits three rows in some flows: attempt (candidate), serve (final), and a quota_reject when gateway blocks. Billing ledger only consumes the serve rows. Preview is nearline and optimized for speed so it currently sums any token-bearing row.
leah_support: rough customer impact: users see a higher "estimated invoice" in console, open tickets, then get calmer when final invoice reduces. Support workload spikes. We need clearer UX and better align preview with billed numbers.
zoe_product: product asks: default preview should reflect billed tokens (post-quota and post-selection). But we still want an easy way to view "potential" costs (requested) for debugging. Idea: default to billed, add a toggle "include_attempts & requested". Also a short explainer link on the card.
arjun_metering: implementation options: 1) nearline ingestion filters non-billable rows (attempts/rejects) before aggregation; 2) tag rows with `billing_phase` and change preview aggregation to sum served by default; 3) keep raw ingestion but add a fast aligned view computed via lightweight dedupe on request_id/serve_id. I prefer option 2: add `billing_phase` at emit and have preview prefer served rows when present. Backfill for old events is tricky.
matt_platform: option 2 is good. How do we handle legacy clients that don't set request_id? Preview dedupe currently uses fingerprint||tenant||hour. For retries or routing attempts we should prefer request_id when present. Perhaps preview dedupe key = request_id || fingerprint||tenant||hour.
arjun_metering: agreed. Also recommend storing a 64-bit hash for request_id in nearline to keep index compact. We'll document collision risk.
leah_support: UI work: show small badge on preview card: "Default view = billed tokens. Toggle to include requested attempts." If preview_delta > 10% vs historical ledger, show a warning "Preview includes non-billable events. See breakdown." Also include endpoint query param `window_mode=served|requested|both`.
zoe_product: nice. For rollout: add emit tagging in runtime (billing_phase=requested|served|throttled) -> update nearline normalizer to pick billing_phase when present -> update preview API to default to served and include `preview_meta` with per-phase counts and `included_sources`. Gate the nearline normalizer behind `preview_classify_phase` feature flag.
arjun_metering: telemetry items: preview_phase_breakdown metric (per-tenant served/requested/throttled tokens), preview_delta_reason label (e.g., quota_throttling, routing_attempts). Alert if requested_tokens > 1.25x served_tokens for top-50 tenants or if preview_ingest_p95 latency increases after enabling classification.
matt_platform: perf concern: classification adds ~20-40ms per nearline insert. We'll sample during canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and watch backpressure. If headroom insufficient, fall back to a nightly reconciler job that runs a de-dup pass for the last 72h.
leah_support: support asks for a quick debug endpoint to fetch a side-by-side preview: {served, requested, throttled} and `preview_meta.inferred=true` when billing_phase was inferred (older events). Also need KB copy explaining why preview != invoice. I'll draft that.
arjun_metering: engineering note: for routing attempts vs serve we also need to stop counting attempt rows as billable by default. That means updating the preview SQL/aggregation to filter where billing_phase='served' OR billing_phase IS NULL AND fallback to legacy logic. Also ensure mobile clients ignore new optional `preview_meta` when parsing.
zoe_product: UX: show both numbers for 7 days side-by-side in tenant billing panel after rollout so customers can compare. Also a small timeline control to inspect when throttling/spikes happened.
matt_platform: I'll open a ticket and own the nearline change. plan: emit tagging PR -> preview normalizer flag -> preview API & UI toggles -> canary ramp -> monitor telemetry -> full rollout.
arjun_metering: i'll add dashboards and alert rules: preview_phase_ratio, preview_ingest_latency, preview_delta_pct. Set pager if preview_delta_pct>20% for top tenants for >15m.
billing-bot: [automated] Created ticket BP-5177: "preview billing_phase + served-default view + preview_meta" assigned to matt_platform, arjun_metering, zoe_product. Link: https://issues.redwood.ai/BP-5177
leah_support: thanks — we'll prepare support template and a canned query for quick checks.
matt_platform: anyone object to the plan?
zoe_product: no objections. small ask: add `preview_meta.delta_reason` string when delta > 10% to help pinpoint root cause.
arjun_metering: will add that to the API response.
leah_support: locking owners: matt_platform -> nearline + rollout, arjun_metering -> telemetry + dedupe hash, zoe_product -> UI/KB, leah_support -> support comms. Sync in #eng-platform-ops in 30m. :thumbsup:
